subsetPolicyRationale: `s.flow.flow@1` is this plugin's own self-contained flow graph — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-widget, delete-widget, reorder-widgets, replace-widget, connect-widgets, disconnect-widgets, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
